data.body: **P2 — Do not re-propagate an ambient trace rejected by `InvocationOtelPlugin`.** `copy_context()` copies the caller’s current OTel span unchanged. When the active Lambda span is on a different trace, `InvocationOtelPlugin` deliberately uses the execution ancestor for durable spans but leaves that unrelated span current, so top-level handler spans now inherit the unrelated trace while durable spans and log correlation use the execution trace. Bind the plugin’s resolved invocation parent as the current OTel context before this handoff, detach it at invocation end, and add an end-to-end different-trace ambient case.
